mainText: Hello, Verona! At 10 PM, here is today's balanced dish: we have overcast skies and 68 degrees at Badger Prairie County Park under a New Moon, with an overnight low of 66 degrees and no rain predicted.

The Verona Senior Center is looking for volunteers to assist with their services, requiring a commitment of two shifts per month and a confidentiality agreement. Additionally, City Hall has released official notices regarding the upcoming fall partisan primary and the November general election.

Today you can catch live music at Bailey's Run or the Wisconsin Brewing Company. Tomorrow, check out the Dane County Farmers' Market at the Capitol, live music at Paddy Mac's, or the adults-only Cave Carnival at Cave of the Mounds.
In our weekly police report, on Wednesday, August 6, an officer observed a driver acting erratically and arrested the individual for their fourth O W I offence.
Indulge in today's flavor, Caramel Fudge Cookie Dough, but head over quickly as Culver's closes in less than an hour. If you miss out, tomorrow's flavor is Turtle.
